description: This PHP class defines the ElasticLoadBalancingClient in the AWS SDK, providing methods to interact with the Elastic Load Balancing service, including operations for managing load balancers, policies, and tags.

classes.name: ElasticLoadBalancingClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS Elastic Load Balancing service, extending the generic AwsClient to support specific API operations.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a load balancer.

methods.name: addTagsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a load balancer.

methods.name: applySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
methods.description: Applies security groups to a load balancer.

methods.name: applySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously applies security groups to a load balancer.

methods.name: attachLoadBalancerToSubnets
methods.description: Attaches a load balancer to subnets.

methods.name: attachLoadBalancerToSubnetsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attaches a load balancer to subnets.

methods.name: configureHealthCheck
methods.description: Configures health check for a load balancer.

methods.name: configureHealthCheckAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously configures health check for a load balancer.

methods.name: createAppCookieStickinessPolicy
methods.description: Creates a stickiness policy based on application cookies.

methods.name: createAppCookieStickinessPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an application cookie stickiness policy.

methods.name: createLBCookieStickinessPolicy
methods.description: Creates a load balancer cookie stickiness policy.

methods.name: createLBCookieStickinessPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a load balancer cookie stickiness policy.

methods.description: Creates a new load balancer.

methods.name: createLoadBalancerAsync

methods.name: createLoadBalancerListeners

methods.name: createLoadBalancerListenersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates listeners for a load balancer.

methods.name: createLoadBalancerPolicy
methods.description: Creates a policy for a load balancer.

methods.name: createLoadBalancerPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a policy for a load balancer.

methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a load balancer.

methods.description: Asynchronously deletes listeners from a load balancer.

methods.name: deleteLoadBalancerPolicy

methods.name: deleteLoadBalancerPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a load balancer policy.

methods.name: deregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancerAsync

methods.description: Asynchronously describes account limits for ELB.

methods.name: describeInstanceHealthAsync

methods.description: Asynchronously describes load balancer policy types.
